classdef.name: ParagraphShadingBottomOriginEnum
classdef.shortdesc: Options for specifying basis of the bottom origin of the paragraph shading.

property.name: DESCENT_BOTTOM_ORIGIN
property.shortdesc: Makes the paragraph shading bottom origin based on descent of the text in the paragraph.

property.name: BASELINE_BOTTOM_ORIGIN
property.shortdesc: Makes the paragraph shading bottom origin based on baseline of the text in the paragraph.
